title: Sparkly snow globe
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles around globe -->
  <g fill='#FFE97A'>
    <polygon points='18,22 20,17 22,22 27,24 22,26 20,31 18,26 13,24'/>
    <polygon points='82,18 84,13 86,18 91,20 86,22 84,27 82,22 77,20'/>
    <polygon points='12,52 14,48 16,52 20,54 16,56 14,60 12,56 8,54'/>
    <polygon points='88,60 90,56 92,60 96,62 92,64 90,68 88,64 84,62'/>
    <polygon points='78,82 79,79 80,82 83,83 80,84 79,87 78,84 75,83'/>
    <polygon points='22,80 23,77 24,80 27,81 24,82 23,85 22,82 19,81'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Globe base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='27' ry='8' fill='#8B5E3C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='25' ry='7' fill='#A8724A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='6' fill='#C48850'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='18' ry='4.5' fill='#D89C60'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='14' ry='3.5' fill='#E8B070'/>

  <!-- Globe glass sphere -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='30' fill='#2B4A7A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='28' fill='#3D6DB5'/>

  <!-- Snow inside globe -->
  <g fill='#E8F0FF'>
    <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='45' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='55' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='52' cy='58' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='45' cy='48' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='1.7'/>
    <circle cx='35' cy='45' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='65' cy='38' r='1.3'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='62' r='1.4'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='60' r='1.6'/>
    <circle cx='48' cy='65' r='1.2'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Snowman inside globe -->
  <!-- Bottom snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='#F0F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='9' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Middle snowball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='7' fill='#F0F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='7' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='5' fill='#F0F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='39' r='5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Snowman face -->
  <circle cx='48' cy='38' r='0.8' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='38' r='0.8' fill='#2A2A2A'/>
  <polygon points='50,39 54,40.5 50,41' fill='#FF8C38'/>

  <!-- Buttons -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='47' r='0.8' fill='#D04040'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='0.8' fill='#D04040'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='53' r='0.8' fill='#D04040'/>

  <!-- Scarf -->
  <rect x='44' y='43' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#E04040'/>
  <rect x='53' y='44' width='2.5' height='5' rx='1' fill='#E04040'/>

  <!-- Hat -->
  <rect x='45' y='33' width='10' height='2' rx='0.5' fill='#303030'/>
  <rect x='46' y='28' width='8' height='6' rx='1' fill='#303030'/>

  <!-- Globe highlight/reflection -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='38' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.15' transform='rotate(-20 38 38)'/>

  <!-- Globe rim highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='29' fill='none' stroke='#6FA8DC' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
